competitions.result: Fourth round — lost 2–0 to Leeds United at Elland Road in a replay, after a 0–0 draw at Anfield.
Fourth round — lost 2–1 away to West Ham United.
Second round — lost 3–1 on aggregate to Bayern Munich after a 0–0 home draw and a 3–1 away defeat.
Runners-up — lost 1–0 to Leicester City at Filbert Street.

in.note: Signed in May 1971 for the incoming campaign; made his competitive debut in August.

overview: Liverpool finished third with 57 points, just one behind champions Derby County. A 1–0 defeat at Derby and a goalless draw at Arsenal in their final two league games left them short of the title.

Kevin Keegan arrived from Scunthorpe United and scored on his competitive debut in a 3–1 home win over Nottingham Forest. He finished with 11 goals in all competitions, while John Toshack led the scoring with 13, all in the league. Ian St John, Tommy Lawrence and Ron Yeats left the club during 1971.

There was no trophy in the cups either. Leeds United won an FA Cup fourth-round replay, West Ham United ended the League Cup run at the same stage, and Bayern Munich beat Liverpool 3–1 on aggregate in the second round of the Cup Winners’ Cup. The campaign had begun with a 1–0 Charity Shield defeat by Leicester City.

events.title: Keegan scores on debut
events.detail: Keegan scored in Liverpool’s 3–1 league win over Nottingham Forest at Anfield.

events.title: A goalless finish at Highbury
events.detail: Liverpool drew 0–0 with Arsenal in their final league fixture and finished one point behind Derby County.

researchNotes: Toshack’s 13 goals were all scored in the league and were also Liverpool’s highest all-competition total. The Charity Shield is included among competitive matches; Liverpool did not score in it.
The three clubs on 57 points were separated by goal average, not modern goal difference. No disputed refereeing decision is needed to explain the final table.
Keegan’s signing is allocated to this incoming campaign. Published accounts give both £33,000 and £35,000, so no fee is stated.
St John is recorded as leaving into free agency rather than as a direct transfer to Coventry. The precise terms of his intervening spell outside England are not asserted.
